# Design assets: icons, logo, illustrations, characters, animations, backgrounds

**Rule (owner's):** visual assets are generated by the owner's **ChatGPT** from exact prompts - never improvised or hand-drawn ad hoc by Claude. Claude writes the prompt, validates the result, integrates it, and documents it. (Exception that happened: when ChatGPT output was unusable, Claude built tooling to *process* ChatGPT sheets - never to invent art.)

## 1. The loop
1. **Design language first** (`docs/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md`, single source of truth): personality in 3 words, audience, palette tokens (light + dark, ink 4.5:1, UI glyphs 3:1), icon grid/stroke/caps/radius, style packs, motion rules, hard rules (original work only, CC0, no text in art, RTL-safe `-start/-end` pairs), the technical contract (allowed SVG elements, sizes, `currentColor`/token classes, naming, size budget for APK + service-worker precache).
2. **Write the prompt** to `docs/prompts/<NAME>_PROMPT.md` (a fenced block the owner pastes as is): audience + principles; the style system and colours restated (every prompt restates the design language so assets stay one family); exact formats/sizes/rules the app validates; **staged delivery** ("wait for 'continue'" between stages: concepts -> model sheet -> sheets); original-work/CC0; motion safety (+ still first frame, loops >= 800 ms, "calm animations" switch); a validation/report section where ChatGPT must honestly list anything off-model/clipped.
3. Register it in `docs/PENDING_CHATGPT_PROMPTS.md` (what it covers, what it blocks, status) and **stop building that part** until results arrive. Give the owner the prompt in the reply (Hebrew framing, English prompt body is fine).
4. **Validate** the returned zip in its own empty directory (untrusted; run Python with `-I`): file names, formats, sizes, only allowed SVG elements (`scripts/check-*-svg.mjs`), contrast, transparent backgrounds without halos, consistent scale/baseline across frames; look at the rendered sheets (contact sheets) before integrating.
5. **Integrate**: copy sources into `design/<kit>/` (untouched originals), generate app assets with a script in `scripts/` (committed), add files to SHELL, add tests (static existence, size budget), update DESIGN_LANGUAGE + PENDING list + CONTEXT file map + CHANGELOG, regenerate screenshots/guide images.
6. **If it is not good, say so** and either request a correction prompt (`ROUND9D`-style: list each defect) or switch approach - the owner decided between options several times (puppet rig vs sprite cycles vs human designer brief). Do not integrate "almost fine" work and do not claim a component fits without checking licence and size.

## 2. What was produced for StepUp (reference example - other domains swap the subject: e.g. a family-routine app got an avatar studio, scenery kits and calm animations; a religious-text app needs calm typography and no characters)
Momentum style kit (tokens + 54 UI icons, 4 packs trail/coast/ember/sunlight, light+dark) -> richer duotone icons + brand mark (Round 3/4 logo) -> Trail logo-born character V3-V5 (rig poses, 15 poses) -> designer-rig / designer brief -> illustrated standalone character (Round 10: model sheet, 8-frame walk/run strips, 16 poses; processed by `scripts/make-character-sprites.py` into WebP sprite sheets; flat magenta background instead of alpha to avoid halos) -> follow-up for true loops (Round 11) -> puppet engine `puppetRig.js` (shelved). Also backgrounds/banners, onboarding/empty-state art, weather art, badges, widget backgrounds, celebration art, countdown numerals, Android adaptive icon/splash. Sister app SonRise: avatar pack, calm animation, scenery kits (1-3), widget kit, icon pack, visual-kit fix rounds (`morning_organizer/docs/*_PROMPT.md` are good templates).

## 3. Technical lessons
* Magenta (or other flat key colour) background, not "transparent": ChatGPT's alpha gives halos; key it out with Pillow/numpy. Restrict skin/hair detection to the head area (soles matched "hair" colour once).
* Sprite cycles: exact registration (baseline, hip x, scale) between frames; cross-dissolved in-betweens and re-ordering frames were rejected; an 8-frame walk ~1.2 s, run ~0.7 s; still first frame; reduced-motion shows a still pose.
* SVG art: tokens via CSS classes/`currentColor`, no scripts/images/foreignObject, `-start/-end` for directional glyphs, light + dark variants, each file small; static check lists allowed elements.
* Logo/app icon: layered adaptive icon + PNG sizes via `scripts/make-icons.mjs` / `make-android-art.mjs`; maskable icon in the manifest.
* Generated data modules (`iconData.js`, `brandData.js`, `characterData.js`) come from scripts; never edit by hand.
* Screenshots for the in-app guide are regenerated with the e2e journey (`GUIDE_DIR=web/art/guide`) after any UI change.
